description: Investment appraisal for a cash-flow series: NPV at a discount rate, IRR (all roots for non-conventional flows), MIRR, profitability index, simple and discounted payback; with dates gives Excel-compatible XNPV and XIRR. POST JSON body {cashFlows, ratePct, dates?}. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/npv-irr

cashFlows.description: Cash flows per period starting at t=0 (investments negative)

dates.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date per cash flow for XNPV / XIRR (Actual/365)

ratePct.description: Discount rate per period (or per year with dates), percent

title: Npv Irr
